effects.printed_clause: When a card is activated as Chain Link 3 or higher while you control only DARK monsters, including at least 1 Scarstech monster (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand or GY.
effects.lua_implementation: The Chain Link 3-or-higher condition now treats every controlled monster that is not currently DARK—including a face-down monster—as disqualifying, while separately requiring a face-up Scarstech monster.
effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: a face-down monster cannot prove the 'only DARK monsters' condition because it has no public/current DARK Attribute.

effects.printed_clause: If a card or effect is activated as Chain Link 3 or higher while this card is face-up: You can Link Summon 1 Galaxy monster using monsters you control as material.
effects.lua_implementation: An EVENT_CHAINING field trigger checks ev>=3, builds all face-up controlled monsters as material group, filters Galaxy Link Monsters with IsLinkSummonable, and calls Duel.LinkSummon.

official_references.matched_structure: Quick/triggered Link Summon using monsters the player controls.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of Scarstech Beacon once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The self-summon and Link Summon effects use id and id+100 hard once-per-turn keys.

official_references.matched_structure: Hard once-per-turn immediate Link Summon effect.

coverage_override.reason: Three records cover Chain-3 self-Summon, Chain-3 Link Summon trigger, and per-effect HOPT.
